changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Feature (October 29, 2026)
changes.detail: Managed OpenTelemetry for GKE is generally available (GA) on clusters running GKE version 1.37.1-gke.1697000 or later. You can collect OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) traces, metrics, and logs from your workloads with a Google-managed collector instead of a self-managed OpenTelemetry Collector deployment: Configure otlp_grpc in the Instrumentation custom resource (GKE version 1.37.1-gke.1697000 or later), or send telemetry directly to the in-cluster collector's gRPC endpoint on port 4317 in addition to HTTP on port 4318. changes.title: Identity and Access Management: Feature (October 29, 2026)
changes.detail: The Admin ( roles/admin ), Writer ( roles/writer ), and Reader ( roles/reader ) basic roles are generally available ( GA ). For more information, see Basic roles . The legacy basic roles—Owner ( roles/owner ), Editor ( roles/editor ), and Viewer ( roles/viewer )—are still available for use and are being actively maintained. However, if you need to grant a basic role, we recommend granting the Admin, Writer, or Reader role instead of a legacy basic role. This is because the newer roles support additional features, such as the use of IAM Conditions .
